claims.text: Herpes zoster: valacyclovir 1 g three times daily for 7 days (most effective within 48 hours of rash),
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of VALTREX for treatment of herpes zoster is 1 gram 3 times daily for 7 days. Therapy should be initiated at the earliest sign or symptom of herpes zoster and is most effective when started within 48 hours of the onset of rash.

claims.text: or acyclovir 800 mg every 4 hours, 5 times daily for 7 to 10 days.
claims.quote: Acute Treatment of Herpes Zoster: 800 mg every 4 hours orally, 5 times daily for 7 to 10 days.

claims.text: Chickenpox in children 2 years and older: acyclovir 20 mg/kg per dose 4 times daily for 5 days (over 40 kg: adult dose).
claims.quote: Children (2 years of age and older): 20 mg/kg per dose orally 4 times daily (80 mg/kg/day) for 5 days. Children over 40 kg should receive the adult dose for chickenpox.
claims.locator: Dosage and Administration › Treatment of Chickenpox

claims.text: Keep patients adequately hydrated (acyclovir can precipitate in renal tubules)
claims.quote: Precipitation of acyclovir in renal tubules may occur when the solubility (2.5 mg/mL) is exceeded in the intratubular fluid. Adequate hydration should be maintained for all patients.
claims.locator: 5 Warnings and Precautions › Acute Renal Failure

claims.text: and reduce the dose in renal impairment.
claims.quote: Dosage reduction is recommended when administering VALTREX to patients with renal impairment
claims.locator: 5 Warnings and Precautions › Acute Renal Failure
